responses.message: Tell me the story of the rising sun.
Tell me the story of the silver moon.

suite.message: You look rather tired. Care to hear a story? I've got plenty to tell...
A lovely story, one that I'll happily recount again and again...
Go, now, child. It is a new day.
A harrowing tale, that one. But the moral is important, so I'll tell it.
Rest, now, child. Night has fallen, and the cold world awaits you.
Be thankful for all your another-times. There are fewer of them than you might expect.
